fields.description:
## Context / Problem
On `origin/main` at `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`, `.github/dependabot.yml` configures weekly uv updates and monthly GitHub Actions updates. `CONTRIBUTING.md:671-678` still says updates are Actions-only, while `docs/releasing.md:588-593` gives stale ecosystem/cadence guidance. These user-facing instructions contradict the active configuration.

## Approach
Update both documents from `.github/dependabot.yml` as the source of truth. State the two ecosystems and their differing cadences, including the committed-lock uv behavior, without duplicating lower-level configuration likely to drift.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Both documents describe weekly uv and monthly GitHub Actions updates.
- [ ] The guidance names the lock-backed uv update behavior without duplicating volatile configuration.
- [ ] Documentation checks and `make lint` pass.
fields.title: Align Dependabot documentation with weekly uv and monthly Actions updates
